BiblicalUsage: Omnah is the adverb surely, indeed, truly. Abraham says in Genesis 20:12, and yet indeed she is my sister, and Achan says in Joshua 7:20, indeed I have sinned against the Lord God of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe indeed is the word of a confession and a half-truth alike, and the difference is whether the speaker is hiding or telling.
RelatedEvents: Abraham and Abimelech; The Defeat at Ai and Achan's Sin
